label: context.reference
text:
A lifecycle.connection is an immutable run-bound snapshot validated by system_lifecycle_events/connection.schema.json and the provider decoder. Each handler records its source layer/path/trust and the SHA-256 of its canonical destination JSON; enabled untrusted or modified handlers are refused.

Bind the exact ArtifactRef to the run and repeat it in the provider's lifecycle_connection pin. The formed grant must admit system_lifecycle_events, each handler destination and lifecycle.decision.allowed for sync edges. Multiple sync handlers for one held continuation require an authored aggregate decision edge; otherwise they are refused. Async matches produce separate sibling movements. The connection artifact grants no authority.
